title.narrative: 2017 / 391-119 - Social Cohesion for Better Service Delivery in Rakhine State

description.narrative: The project aims to enhance civil society organisations and local authorities contribution to governance and development processes in Rakhine State. This will be done by strengthening civil society organisations, especially women and youth organisations, in their collaboration with local authorities and provision of services to divided communities. More precisely, the expected outputs of the project are: 1) Increased research initiatives and dialogue between local authorities and civil society organisations about gaps and issues related to mutual collaboration, conflict sensitivity and service delivery processes; 2) Established collaboration and partnership among youth and women civil society organisations for design and planning of service delivery in local communities; 3) Supported joint actions between civil society and local authorities in service delivery planning and budgeting; 4) Raised evidence-based awareness of issues related to collaboration between local authorities and civil society and service delivery by conducting community-based campaigns.

department.narrative: Delegation of the European Union to Burma/Myanmar
